description: Gets the layout definition item assigned to an item -- the Sitecore layout item itself (e.g. 'Headless Layout'), not the renderings placed on the page. Use presentation-list-renderings to see a page's components.

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout to be retrieved. If 'true', the final layout is retrieved, otherwise - shared layout.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to retrieve layout for. Supply this or path.

language.description: Specifies the item language to retrieve layout.

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve layout for. Supply this or id.

name: presentation-get-layout
